text: Aspirin relieved her fever after a meal of hummus. She takes metformin for type 2 diabetes, has high blood pressure, and drank green tea every morning. Last winter she was given amoxicillin for pneumonia and told to eat more salmon, lentils and olive oil while cutting back on table sugar. Her brother has asthma, uses salbutamol, and gets migraines after red wine or dark chocolate.
